title: Rabbi Abba HaKohen son of Rabbi Eliezer
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 80:4, where Rabbi Chanina speaks in his name. Hyman calls that reading a scribal error and says it should read as cited there at 76:9: “Rav Huna in the name of Abba Kohen Bardala.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 76:9 fully writes Rav Huna in the name of Rabbi Abba HaKohen Bardela, supporting Rav Huna for ר״ה. Hyman’s comparison with 80:4 and his proposed name correction remain his argument; this digital witness is not printed-page proof.

Midrash Rabbah–TE Bereshit Rabbah 80:4 names Rabbi Chanina in the name of Rabbi Abba HaKohen be-Rabbi Eliezer; 76:9 names Rav Huna in the name of Rabbi Abba HaKohen Bardela. The claim of scribal error and the statement that the reading should be changed remain Hyman’s judgment. These digital witnesses do not establish the printed correction history.
